basis: Independent review of Hospital 4; Hospital 1 policies are not imported.
premium_scope: all_delivered_units_on_day; equal-quantity duplicate descriptions counted once for context; delivered context inferred from billing, not independent delivery evidence
volume_scope: UNRESOLVED: population and reset horizon not specified; lower usage bound zero, upper bound contract-wide billed usage; only invariant rates are payable
volume_quantity: billed_units_as_working_upper_bound; no corrected quantities; missing or incompatible units produce unknown upper bounds
line_order: ascending lexical; validate H4 fixed-width identifiers
caps: Section 6.1 excess nonpayable; min(inferred delivered quantity, cap) for the retained eligible occurrence; corrected amount is an approved assumption-dependent estimate, not established actual delivered quantity
duplicates: earliest eligible ascending lexical line ID for exact copies only: same service/patient/date/quantity/unit/unit price/line charge; identical multi-unit copies included; conflicting quantities, rates or eligibility unresolved; H1 price-aware selection not adopted
exclusions: inclusive <= N days; same patient across invoices in either temporal direction; exclude only first-column service; approved interpretation supported by analogous H1 wording/labels, not H4 validation
ambiguous_unit: per hour, per item retained verbatim; no conversion or rate choice; all affected calculations reviewed
valid_dates: inclusive term endpoints interpretation; invalid service dates flagged, no automatic zero
submission_gate: known integer expected total (including approved cap estimate), decisive flag, no blocking uncertainty, unique header ID, valid source cents; report amount assumptions separately
uncertainty: propagate candidate presence and quantity uncertainty; do not replace unknown with zero

cap_correction.confidence_note: Existing class heuristic unchanged; no cap-specific calibration or invented numerical penalty. H1 four cap cases imply below-cap quantities; latent original quantity explanation unproven.

duplicate_retention.requires: consistent known eligibility and adjusted rate; no uncertain related occurrences

wrong_units: case-specific independent quantity evidence required; no quantity inferred from prices or blanket unit-label typo assumption; no new H4 quantity evidence supplied
